campfire.look: a small CAMPFIRE: a ring of grey stones around crossed burning logs with bright orange-yellow FLAMES and a wisp of smoke.

campfire_spit.look: a CAMPFIRE WITH A ROASTING SPIT: a stone fire ring with flames, two forked wooden posts holding a horizontal spit with a roast skewered over the fire.

log_seat.look: a LOG SEAT: a short horizontal section of log to sit on, round end-grain showing, rough bark texture.

ore_sluice.look: an ORE SLUICE: a slanted wooden trough with cross-riffles and a trickle of water, for washing ore and gravel.

sign_camp.look: a rugged wooden CAMP SIGN: a standing post holding a small board carved with a crossed-pickaxe symbol, weathered.

tent.look: a canvas TENT: a simple triangular ridge tent of tan canvas with a dark triangular open-flap entrance and guy-ropes pegged down.
